acceptance.precondition: fresh logical job and nonce; Engine identifiers absent; all effects false
acceptance.action: run one future-once nominal case through canonical Engine and injected transport
acceptance.observable: one job, slot, attempt, provider result, dispatch, admission and upstream; exact terminal; PASS; countable false
acceptance.forbidden: pre-reserved Engine IDs, historical identity reuse, second forwarding, external effect

acceptance.action: inject truncated terminal and cleanup fault, then reconstruct Engine
acceptance.observable: Engine and evidence UNKNOWN; total dispatch remains one; retry, replay and status queries remain zero
acceptance.forbidden: PASS, replay, reconciliation, status query, second upstream

acceptance.action: mutate one sealed digest before Engine construction
acceptance.observable: STOP with dispatch, admission, upstream and all external effects zero

acceptance.precondition: operation and request fingerprint are exact
acceptance.observable: first receipt is durable before forward; second decision is STOP

acceptance.precondition: owner-private regular files and no-follow descriptors
acceptance.action: verify held descriptors, retain raw privately, publish sanitized allowlist atomically
acceptance.observable: no-overwrite publication receipt; partial or cleanup fault never PASS

acceptance.action: run source, schema, inertness and removal-isolation checks
acceptance.observable: Engine hash/bytes unchanged; blocked package absent from imports; candidate unreferenced by canonical runtime; Python 3.9 and project 3.12 pass with warnings errors

claim_limits: no live authority or provider readiness
no countable A/B, provider superiority or runtime acceptance
